newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Forward to acquire MacPhail, Gentyre.
newsitem.headline: Forward to acquire MacPhail, Gentyre.

text.p: Forward Corp Ltd said on Wednesday it planned through subsidiaries to acquire all of MacPhail Holdings Ltd's and Gentyre Industries Ltd's shares in their respective subsidiaries, effective June 30.

Tyremaker Gentyre, which conducts business only through its subsidiaries, would received just over 52 million fully paid ordinary shares in Forward as well as cash of 158.148 million rand which would be distributed to shareholders.
MacPhail would receive 14.33 million rand, also to be distributed to shareholders.
Following the acquisitions, Gentyre and McPhail will undergo reductions of capital, will be delisted and will be wound up, liquidated or deregistered.
